853:t_1:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh... Being called an ace all over again makes me feel bashful.」

853:t_1:5.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Don't let it go to your head, $$勝平$$.」

853:t_1:6.en:
$$恵子$$
「That's right. You're the main pilot, but we're $$ザンボット３$$ pilots too.」

853:t_1:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heheh! Say what you want, but I pilot $$ザンボエース$$, so I'm literally the ace!」

853:t_1:8.en:
$$恵子$$
「What kind of excuse is that...?!」

853:t_1:9.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Your logic is as childish as ever.」

853:t_1:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You fight because you're so close... Please keep giving it your all with love, courage and strength.」

853:t_2:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. I'm sorry to put you to all this trouble.」

853:t_2:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You take it so calmly... That's just what I'd expect of you.」

853:t_2:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yet you show fierce anger toward your enemies... You truly are Mr. Gallant, $$万丈$$.」

853:t_2:7.en:
$$万丈$$
「If you understand that, please refrain from any funny business, $$ＡＧ$$.」

853:t_2:8.en:
$$万丈$$
「For the sake of the world and its people, I intend to stop every evil ambition.」

853:t_2:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand. I don't want to be torn apart like iron bars, either.」

853:t_3:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$. It's nice to get praise, even when it's from you.」

853:t_3:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's cruel...! You're a president who leads others, yet you make such discriminatory remarks!」

853:t_3:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'm sorry...! I didn't mean it that way...」

853:t_3:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Listen, $$ワッ太$$. A president's words have a powerful effect on the employees.」

853:t_3:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To fire up your employees, you must keep lighting a fire under them, even when being president feels so tough!」

853:t_3:9.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I think everyone would hate it if I lit a fire under them...」

853:t_4:4.en:
$$柿小路$$
「I didn't earn this title through my efforts alone. Please congratulate every employee individually.」

853:t_4:11.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Next, my wife and twelve children, who have supported me...」

853:t_4:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Um... Could you please give me a break? I'm quite serious...」

853:t_5:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I'm glad to hear you say that, but I didn't do this on my own.」

853:t_5:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I know. Then let me try again...」

853:t_5:8.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. I'm sure $$鉄人$$ is happy too.」

853:t_5:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your strength must come from being able to say that without a trace of embarrassment, $$正太郎$$.」

853:t_6:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, $$ブラックオックス#pilot$$!」

853:t_6:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Huh... Congratulations aren't enough? Where did this child learn to be so demanding...?」

853:t_6:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, yes, I understand. Here, then... $$ロボビタンＢ$$, the tonic robots swear by!」

853:t_6:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Huh... You've never heard of that power part? Are you saying you can eat wakame bread or $$郁絵$$'s snacks?!」

853:t_6:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll put those petty objections aside and lovingly oil you today. Will that do, $$オックス$$?」

853:t_6:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Good grief... Looking after children is hard work, but it does soothe the soul...)

853:t_7:4.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Don't come any closer. I simply cannot trust you.」

853:t_7:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Whaaat?! $$ロビー$$ used to serve you, and wasn't that robot much the same?!」

853:t_7:6.en:
$$グーラ$$
「That one had hidden motives and was untrustworthy too. I sense the same thing in you.」

853:t_7:7.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...Or so I'd like to say, but as the son of the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, I have neither the right nor the standing to say that.」

853:t_7:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you can humbly admit your faults like that, $$グーラ$$, you can walk alongside everyone else.」

853:t_7:9.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Then you should learn some humility too.」

853:t_8:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. I appreciate all your hard work too.」

853:t_8:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「With that bright smile and consideration for others, you're a true classic hero!」

853:t_8:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But, $$タケル$$... It's dangerous to give love away too freely.」

853:t_8:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「What do you mean, give love away freely...?」

853:t_8:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In other words, if you carelessly use the word 'love' too much...」

853:t_8:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「What happens if I use it too much?」

853:t_8:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You'll turn into a long-tailed monkey from a southern island whose face looks scary up close.」

853:t_8:11.en:
$$タケル$$
「What the heck is that supposed to mean...?! I wasted my time taking you seriously.」

853:t_8:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(But, $$タケル$$... Excessive brotherly love can sometimes give the ladies the wrong idea. Do be careful.)

853:t_9:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And while I'm at it, Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, $$ナオト$$, $$アキラ$$, $$ミカ$$ and $$ロゼ$$!」

853:t_9:5.en:
$$ナオト$$
「Hey, $$ＡＧ$$... Are we just extras tagging along with our captain?」

853:t_9:6.en:
$$アキラ$$
「But if we're talking about that, hasn't $$コスモクラッシャー$$ itself become an extra tagging along with $$ゴッドマーズ$$ lately?」

853:t_9:7.en:
$$ミカ$$
「In terms of combat strength, I guess we have become that, but...」

853:t_9:8.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「What are you saying? Our mission is to support $$タケル$$. What's wrong with being extras?」

853:t_9:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ケンジ$$ is right. Your devoted efforts are what allow $$タケル$$ to fight.」

853:t_9:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... For one of you, we could call it the power of love.」

853:t_9:11.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「S-stop giving me that lewd look, $$ＡＧ$$!」
